title: Entitlement request
description: Body of POST /v1/entitlement. The app sends it after a purchase, on every cold start, when the person changes fields, and when its pass is within 12 hours of expiring. The worker answers 400 bad_request for any body that does not match, or one over 8 KiB.

purchase_token.description: The Play purchase token. Play documents no format, so the worker only limits length and characters (printable ASCII, no spaces).

product_id.description: The subscription product id, in Play's product id format.

fields.description: The person's selected fields, as wire values. Same enum as field in feed-item.schema.json.
